Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a closed-loop electrochemical strategy that selectively recovers cadmium from waste electrolytes into textured Cd(002) anodes, using cesium iodide to stabilize the interface. This enables 99.98% Coulombic efficiency and reversible Cd||I₂ cells, with failed anodes reextractable and regenerable. It significantly advances sustainable Cd waste valorization and aqueous battery reutilization.

item.title: Design guidelines for body-conformable aqueous zinc-based batteries
item.description:

Chemical Society Reviews | ⭐ Review
💡 This review is novel in consolidating design principles, printing methods, stretchable electrodes, structural strategies, and cathode chemistries specifically for body-conformable aqueous zinc-based batteries. Its significance lies in guiding the development of safe, flexible, biocompatible power sources for medical devices, bridging materials innovation and clinical application.
